fields.why: Table 1 tests coverage at ages 14–17 against age 13 (5 ordered groups), and the text ranks insurance groups ('lowest among uninsured') under a blanket z-test statement.

Age (5 interview ages), insurance (4 groups, SES) and MSA status (3 levels, rurality) are the SPDs with 3+ groups assessed; the Table 2 birth-cohort tests within race, poverty, MSA and insurance levels make no entry by themselves (rule 6), so race is rightly left out.

Age is tested against the age-13 referent and 'lowest' insurance rests on a blanket z-test line, both per-group vs referent; the urban-vs-other contrast of cohort declines across MSA levels is interpreted with no test across them, so side by side.
